nodes.label: NSIS installer target (one-click, per-user)
nodes.rationale: Per-user install so no administrator rights are needed.

nodes.label: Calendar page (PTO and Other days)
nodes.rationale: Personal data: it has no Sync card of its own, so it is never part of a Links or Snippets export; only the full backup carries it.

nodes.label: Pictures in the Cases editor ([image N] lines, IndexedDB)
nodes.norm_label: pictures in the cases editor ([image n] lines, indexeddb)
nodes.rationale: Pasted pictures become thumbnails with an [image N] line in the draft; Copy puts pictures into the email for the Salesforce composer, Plain text leaves them out.

nodes.label: Desktop app (Electron, Windows)
nodes.rationale: A window around the built site so every page works as on the web; nothing is sent anywhere and data stays on the computer.

nodes.label: Device API page (Postman for Crestron devices, desktop only)
nodes.norm_label: device api page (postman for crestron devices, desktop only)
nodes.rationale: A web page cannot do the device login (Cookie, Origin, Referer headers and HttpOnly cookies), so the desktop app does it following the DM NVX API manual.

nodes.label: Changes switch (Read only / Changes allowed) and review step
nodes.norm_label: changes switch (read only / changes allowed) and review step
nodes.rationale: Switched off at every start; non-GET calls open a review, run on one unit at a time, and empty objects in a body are warned about because the device deletes an object it is sent empty.

nodes.label: Results Compare view (units side by side, differences highlighted)
nodes.norm_label: results compare view (units side by side, differences highlighted)

nodes.label: Saved calls, folders and Run all (GET only)
nodes.norm_label: saved calls, folders and run all (get only)
nodes.rationale: Run all and folder play run only GET calls so nothing that changes a device ever runs without a review.

nodes.label: Full backup (.zip of the whole folder)
nodes.norm_label: full backup (.zip of the whole folder)

nodes.label: guides/<name>/ per-guide folder (guide.json, images, projects)
nodes.rationale: Images and project zips are referenced relative to the guide's own folder so a guide can be moved on its own.

nodes.label: guides.json (list of guides, source of truth)
nodes.norm_label: guides.json (list of guides, source of truth)

nodes.label: Linked folder (data folder chosen on Sync page)
nodes.norm_label: linked folder (data folder chosen on sync page)
nodes.rationale: Guides, links, case snippets and the calendar are saved into one folder the user picks once, so data stays on the computer and a guide folder is self-contained and movable.

nodes.label: nvx.json (Device API groups, units, saved calls; no passwords)
nodes.norm_label: nvx.json (device api groups, units, saved calls; no passwords)

nodes.label: Organize folders (migrate legacy shared-image guides)
nodes.rationale: Only copies, never moves or deletes originals, previews first, and leaves a guide untouched if not all its files can be copied, so it is safe to retry.

nodes.label: Release files table (setup.exe, portable.exe, latest.yml)
nodes.rationale: The setup installer is the one that updates itself; the portable file runs anywhere but cannot update.

nodes.label: Sharing on the Sync page (Links, Snippets, Guides, Full backup)
nodes.norm_label: sharing on the sync page (links, snippets, guides, full backup)

nodes.label: Terminal page (SSH consoles with xterm.js, desktop only)
nodes.norm_label: terminal page (ssh consoles with xterm.js, desktop only)
nodes.rationale: Like Crestron Toolbox's text console: one SSH session per unit on port 22, connection made by the desktop app, at most 12 terminals, all closed when the app quits.

nodes.label: SSH host key trust (accept-new, Trust the new key)
nodes.norm_label: ssh host key trust (accept-new, trust the new key)

nodes.label: In-page line editing (history, Tab completion from help all)
nodes.norm_label: in-page line editing (history, tab completion from help all)
nodes.rationale: The page redraws the whole line each time so nothing depends on how the unit echoes an erase; history is never saved because a command can hold a password.

nodes.label: Terminal unit card (hostname, firmware, PUF, Web button)
nodes.norm_label: terminal unit card (hostname, firmware, puf, web button)
nodes.rationale: Read on a second hidden shell on the same connection so a slow unit never delays what the user types.

nodes.label: Read-only GitHub update token (encrypted by Windows)
nodes.norm_label: read-only github update token (encrypted by windows)
nodes.rationale: The repository is private, so the app reads releases with a fine-grained Contents read-only token pasted once and kept in update-token.bin, never in the repository or the app.

nodes.label: App updates (check, download, restart and install)
nodes.norm_label: app updates (check, download, restart and install)
nodes.rationale: Nothing installs without a click; only the setup version can replace itself, the portable file can only detect a newer version.

nodes.label: React + TypeScript + Vite template notes (React Compiler, ESLint)
nodes.norm_label: react + typescript + vite template notes (react compiler, eslint)
nodes.rationale: Leftover Vite template boilerplate; the React Compiler is not enabled because of its impact on dev and build performance.

nodes.label: Login safety rules (no retry on failed login, 10 s timeout, passwords memory-only)
nodes.norm_label: login safety rules (no retry on failed login, 10 s timeout, passwords memory-only)
nodes.rationale: A failed login stops the run for that unit instead of retrying so a wrong password cannot lock an account; passwords are never saved.

nodes.label: Private network address restriction (10.x, 172.16-31.x, 192.168.x, 169.254.x)
nodes.rationale: Only private addresses are accepted so the app can never be pointed at the internet; the self-signed certificate is accepted for those requests only.
